title: The Effects of Artificial Intelligence Adoption in the Romanian Energy Sector: A Firm-Level and Sectoral Analysis

live_model.evidence: "we confirmed on the lemmas using GPT-4 Turbo, in order to eliminate ambiguous or marginally related terms and include only recognised AI terms" (Sec. 2.2, Methodology, lexicon construction)

prompt.note: Term-filtering instruction is described narratively, not quoted.

claim.metric: none (GPT-4 Turbo is a preprocessing utility for building an AI-terms dictionary; the paper's headline result is a media-coverage-based 'AI Adoption Score' for energy firms, not an LLM benchmark)

data.source: 2,399 most-cited AI abstracts from Web of Science; AFINN sentiment lexicon

notes: GPT-4 Turbo is used only to filter a term dictionary during preprocessing (role A); no accuracy/agreement number is reported for this filtering step.
